subtitle: Cross-reference of September 13, 2026, confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT (16:17 UTC), with the presidential book at USD 149.26M. Four of the five monitored contracts received a new price: winner, first-round runner-up, first-round third place and impeachment at the Supreme Court. The Senate majority contract does not publish a new price in this round. On the polling side there was no national release on Sep 13, and the most recent national reading remains the Datafolha poll of Sep 11; what came out on the night of Sep 12 were five state-level surveys by the same house.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 47.50% (vol USD 10.92M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT, a fall of 1.00pp against the price confirmed on Sep 12, and 20.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. In the first-round runner-up contract, which publishes a price again, he is at 22.00%. POLL: 39% in the first round and 46% in the runoff pair against Flávio Bolsonaro in the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, the most recent national one, with 2 points of difference that fit inside the 2.0 margin.
fortes: In the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 he appears ahead again in the runoff pair against Flávio Bolsonaro, by 46% to 44%, breaking a run of eight national polls since Sep 6 in which that did not happen.

He wins the five runoff pairs tested by the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, and in three of them the distance falls outside the margin: 48% to 37% against Renan Santos, 48% to 39% against Romeu Zema and 46% to 41% against Ronaldo Caiado.
In the first round of the same house he has 39% against 35%, the widest distance between the two across the three national polls with overlapping fieldwork this week.
fracos: The winner contract eases 1.00pp and gives back one sixth of the 6.00pp rise of the day before, with the spread to the leader widening from 1.45pp to 2.15pp.
The 47.50% sits 20.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16, and the contract has not returned to the August level since then.
In the state surveys Datafolha published on Sep 12 he is behind in three of the five units, in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and the Federal District.
Government approval measured by Genial/Quaest on Sep 7 is 43% against 50% disapproval, and the three most recent houses converge exactly on 50% disapproval.
candidates.analise: September 13 reverses the sign of the previous day, and reverses it by little. The winner contract eased 1.00pp and stands at 47.50% (vol USD 10.92M), against a 6.00pp rise the day before, and the distance to the leader went from 1.45pp to 2.15pp. The proportion is what gives the move its size: yesterday this spread closed 10.00pp in a single day, and today it gives back 0.70pp. Both sides eased, so the one who widened the spread was him pulling back more, not his rival advancing. On the polling side nothing enters on Sep 13, and the most recent national reading remains the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, which puts him ahead in the pair by 46% to 44%, inside the margin, and breaks the run of eight national polls without that. What came out on the night of Sep 12 were five state surveys by the same house, and there the picture is mixed: he leads in Minas Gerais by 37% to 35% and in Pernambuco by 55% to 24%, and is behind in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and the Federal District. The week that begins concentrates twelve national polls between Sep 14 and Sep 18, five of them on the same Sep 17.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 49.65% (vol USD 10.54M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT, a fall of 0.30pp against the price confirmed on Sep 12, and 5.45pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. In the first-round runner-up contract, which publishes a price again, he is at 77.00%. POLL: 35% in the first round and 44% in the runoff pair against Lula in the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, with 2 points of difference that fit inside the 2.0 margin.
fortes: He remains ahead in the winner contract, and the spread to the runner-up WIDENED from 1.45pp to 2.15pp, the first widening since Sep 11.
In the first-round runner-up contract, which publishes a price again in this round, he is at 77.00% against 22.00%.

In the Datafolha state surveys of Sep 12 he leads the first round in São Paulo (35% to 33%), Rio de Janeiro (39% to 35%) and the Federal District (40% to 32%), and wins the runoff pairs in SP by 47% to 42% and in RJ by 49% to 41%.
fracos: The winner contract eases for the second day, now 0.30pp, after having eased 4.00pp on Sep 12.
In the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 he loses the runoff pair by 44% to 46%, and within the house itself the pair is stalled: 43% to 47% on Aug 21, 44% to 46% on Sep 3 and 44% to 46% now.
In the first round of the same house he is behind by 35% to 39%, a distance that falls outside a 2.0 margin.
He remains under Federal Police investigation since July 2026 in the inquiry into the financing of the film Dark Horse, and on Sep 12 the Master case files came to have Edson Fachin as rapporteur.
candidates.analise: September 13 is the second straight day of decline in the winner contract, now 0.30pp, and the 49.65% sits 5.45pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. The accumulated volume in his contract is USD 10.54M. The first-round runner-up contract publishes a price again after not publishing on Sep 12, and puts him at 77.00%: the value falls inside the 75.50% to 80.00% range the book itself recorded on Sep 12, and this book varied between 4.00pp and 9.00pp per day in the readings recorded over the last four days, which is the scale at which it should be read. On the news side, the act of the night of Sep 12 reaches the case in which he is under investigation: Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro and ordered André Mendonça to send him the cases on Banco Master and on the INSS fraud. The order of the facts is measured and the link to the price is not, because the book is continuously arbitraged and no single reading separates one motive from another.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.45% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT, stable for the second day, and 55.60% in the first-round third-place contract (vol USD 173 thousand), where he is the favourite, down 0.20pp. POLL: 6% in the first round in the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, and he loses the runoff pair to Lula by 43% to 45%, inside the 2.0 margin.
fortes: He remains the favourite in the first-round third-place contract with 55.60%, and his gap to the runner-up there WIDENED from 18.80pp to 21.10pp, because the other side fell more than he did.
In the runoff pair of the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 he comes within 2 points of Lula, 43% to 45%, one of the distances that fit inside the margin.
In the Datafolha state surveys of Sep 12 he appears at 7% in São Paulo, his highest value among the five units.
fracos: In the winner contract he remains at 0.45%, below half a point, for the second day.
In the first-round third-place contract he EASES 0.20pp in this round, after having risen 2.90pp on Sep 12.
In the first round of the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 he has 6%, against 6.6% in the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 10, different houses and therefore no series between them.
candidates.analise: His move in this round is small and his neighbour's is the large one. In the first-round third-place contract he eased 0.20pp and stands at 55.60% (vol USD 173 thousand), while the runner-up there fell 2.50pp, and that is why the gap between the two widened from 18.80pp to 21.10pp without him having advanced. In the winner contract he remains at 0.45%. On the polling side, the most recent national reading is the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, which measures him at 6% in the first round and puts him within 2 points of Lula in the runoff pair, 43% to 45%, inside the 2.0 margin. The contrast between the two instruments remains the hardest reading on this name: the polling puts him at 6% and the winner contract price pays 0.45% on him, and the panel records the distance without arbitrating which of the two is right.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 1.85% (vol USD 13.36M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT, up 0.20pp, and 34.50% in the first-round third-place contract (vol USD 300 thousand), down 2.50pp, the largest move of any contract on the panel in this round. POLL: 3% in the first round in the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, and he loses the runoff pair to Lula by 37% to 48%.
fortes: His contract still carries USD 13.36M accumulated, the second largest individual volume in the presidential book, behind only that of Tarcísio de Freitas, with USD 14.07M.
In the winner contract he RISES 0.20pp in this round, one of only two contracts on the panel that rose.
He is the only name outside the top two who appears in all five Datafolha state surveys of Sep 12, with 6% in São Paulo and 4% in Rio de Janeiro.
fracos: Largest move of any contract on the panel in this round, and it is a fall: 2.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, from 37.00% to 34.50%.
It is the second straight day of decline in that contract, after 1.50pp on Sep 12, adding up to 4.00pp in two days.
In the runoff pair of the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 he loses by 37% to 48%, the widest distance of the five pairs tested by the house and the only one above ten points.
candidates.analise: The largest move of any contract on the panel in this round is his, and it is a fall: 2.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, from 37.00% to 34.50%, in a book of USD 300 thousand. It is the second straight day of decline there, adding up to 4.00pp in two days, and the effect is to widen the gap for that contract's favourite without the favourite having advanced. In the winner contract the move is the opposite and it is small: it rose 0.20pp and stands at 1.85%, with USD 13.36M accumulated, the second largest individual volume in the presidential book. On the polling side, the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 measures him at 3% in the first round and puts him eleven points behind in the runoff pair, 37% to 48%, the widest distance of the five pairs the house tested.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado at 0.15% in the winner contract, stable, and 8.50% in the first-round third-place one, up 0.50pp there (vol USD 119 thousand); Romeu Zema at 0.15% (vol USD 7.26M) and Fernando Haddad at 0.05% (vol USD 7.53M), both stable. Confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT. POLL: in the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, Caiado has 4% and Zema 2% in the first round, and both lose the runoff pair to Lula outside the margin.
candidates.subtitle: Back of the field in the reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT (17:20 UTC). ⚠️ THE PODERDATA/AYA OF 10/Sep MEASURES CAIADO AT 2% AND TESTS NEITHER ZEMA NOR HADDAD in the prompted scenario. All three remain below the 0.5% floor of the double reading in the winner contract, so the prices in this band enter as a simple reading.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.25% (vol USD 7.37M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, and below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he stands at 5.00%, on a USD 120 thousand book. In the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep he has 2% in the first round.
caiado.fortes: ⭐ IN BOTH HOUSES OF THE WEEK HE HAS THE TIGHTEST [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRING AFTER THE ONE INVOLVING THE RUNNER-UP: 46% to 43% at BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep, the smallest margin among the three pairings in which that house hands the leader the win, and 41% to 38% at Quaest of 07/Sep. And he rose 0.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, back to 10.00%.
caiado.fracos: ⚠️ In the WINNER contract he remains below the 0.5% floor, and it is the only one of the three universes in which he does not move. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the two houses measure him at 4% and 3%, with no meaningful change against their previous rounds.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% (vol USD 7.43M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, and at the floor of the book. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep does not test him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: He is not tested as a presidential candidate in the national polls of the window, and neither BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep nor Quaest of 07/Sep tests him, so there is no ballot-box reading to cross against the price.
haddad.fracos: The contract remains open under his name by inheritance of the market's design, not by a declared candidacy, and the panel keeps the line only so the residual price is not read as a signal.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% (vol USD 6.85M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he stands at 0.75%, on a USD 50 thousand book. The PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep does not test him in the prompted scenario.
zema.fortes: BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep measures him at 2% in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) scenario that includes Pablo Marçal, against 1% in the scenario without him, and Quaest of 07/Sep measures him at 2%. The three readings fit inside each house's margin of 2 points.
zema.fracos: ⚠️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRINGS HE IS THE MOST COMFORTABLE FOR THE LEADER IN BOTH HOUSES: 47% to 40% at BTG/Nexus and 44% to 33% at Quaest, that is 7 and 11 points of distance. And he stayed put at 0.85% in the first-round third-place contract, behind Pablo Marçal, who stands at 1.75%.

candidates.analise: The block of low-priced names has a single move in this round, and it is in the first-round third-place contract: Ronaldo Caiado rises 0.50pp and reaches 8.50% (vol USD 119 thousand), for the second straight day of gains. In the winner contracts the three are stalled, Caiado and Zema at 0.15% and Haddad at 0.05%, the latter with USD 7.53M accumulated, which shows that large volume and a floor price coexist without contradiction. On the polling side, the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 is harsher on them than the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 10 had been: there Caiado went as far as TYING with Lula at 45.7% in a runoff pair and Zema appeared ahead by two tenths, and in Datafolha the two lose outside the margin, by 41% to 46% and by 39% to 48%. They are different houses measuring the same question four days apart, and the divergence between them is larger than the margin each one declares.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado RISES 0.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, to 8.50%, for the second straight day of gains there.
In the Datafolha state surveys of Sep 12, Caiado appears at 8% in the Federal District, the highest value of any name outside the top two across the five units.
Romeu Zema appears at 5% in Minas Gerais in the state survey by the same house, the state he governs.
fracos: None of the three goes above 4% in the national first round of the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, and the two tested in the runoff lose outside the margin, Caiado by 41% to 46% and Zema by 39% to 48%.
In the winner contracts the three remain below two tenths: Caiado at 0.15%, Zema at 0.15% and Haddad at 0.05%.
Fernando Haddad is not tested in a presidential scenario by the recent national polls, and his contract pays the floor of the book even with USD 7.53M accumulated.

cruzamento: 📈 THE WINNER CONTRACT SPREAD WIDENED FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE Sep 11: Flávio Bolsonaro is at 49.65% (vol USD 10.54M) and Lula at 47.50% (vol USD 10.92M), against 49.95% and 48.50% in the confirmed reading of Sep 12. Both eased, 0.30pp the former and 1.00pp the latter, and the distance went from 1.45pp to 2.15pp. ⚖️ THE PROPORTION IS WHAT GIVES THE MOVE ITS SIZE: yesterday this same spread CLOSED 10.00pp in a single day, and today it gives back 0.70pp, about seven percent of what it moved the day before. And since both sides eased, the one who widened the spread was the runner-up pulling back, not the leader advancing. ⭐ THE LARGEST MOVE OF THE ROUND IS NOT IN THE WINNER CONTRACT: it is the 2.50pp fall of Renan Santos in the first-round third-place contract, from 37.00% to 34.50%, a second straight day of decline there and 4.00pp in two days. The effect is to widen the gap of that contract's favourite, Augusto Cury, from 18.80pp to 21.10pp, even with Cury EASING 0.20pp. 🔁 THE RUNNER-UP CONTRACT PUBLISHES A PRICE AGAIN after not publishing on Sep 12, with Flávio Bolsonaro at 77.00% and Lula at 22.00%. Both fall inside the range the book itself recorded on Sep 12, and in the readings recorded over the last four days this book varied between 4.00pp and 9.00pp per day. 🏛️ AND THE SUPREME COURT IMPEACHMENT CONTRACT GAVE BACK THE WHOLE EXCURSION: 4.60% (vol USD 90 thousand) against 6.70% on Sep 12. In the closing values recorded in the backup it closed Sep 10 at 4.60%, rose to 7.30% on Sep 11 and 6.70% on Sep 12, and today it gives back exactly the 4.60% of Sep 10. It is not an extreme: it remains 21.50pp below the series high, of 26.10% on Sep 11, and 2.50pp above the floor, of 2.10% on Jun 8. The volume of USD 90 thousand is small enough for isolated orders to move the price, and the caveat holds in both directions. 🗳️ ON THE POLLING SIDE THERE WAS NO NATIONAL RELEASE ON Sep 13, and that is calendar. The Superior Electoral Court registry carries TWELVE national polls scheduled for release between Sep 14 and Sep 18, with FIVE of them on the same Sep 17 and the Veritá poll of 40,500 interviews on Sep 18. On Aug 21 two national polls released on the same day went as far as inverting the runoff between them, so five on the same day is the hardest test this window has produced. 📊 WHAT CAME OUT ON THE NIGHT OF Sep 12 WAS STATE-LEVEL and does not enter the national table: five Datafolha surveys, with the leader ahead in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and the Federal District, and the runner-up ahead in Minas Gerais and Pernambuco. 📌 AND THE COURT'S PROCEEDINGS ADVANCED TWICE: on the night of Sep 12 Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro and ordered André Mendonça to send him the cases on Banco Master and on the INSS fraud, and on Sep 13 the Federal Police answered the 24-hour deadline about Vorcaro's phone. The session remains set for Sep 15 and will be broadcast live. The order of the facts is measured, the link between them is not.
